mapper.insert: INSERT INTO turn (id, platform, bot_id, group_id, status, trigger_ids, outbox_ids, silent_reason, error_code, accepted_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{platform}, #{botId}, #{groupId}, #{status}, #{triggerIds}, #{outboxIds}, #{silentReason}, #{errorCode}, #{acceptedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, status, trigger_ids AS triggerIds, outbox_ids AS outboxIds, silent_reason AS silentReason, error_code AS errorCode, accepted_at AS acceptedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt FROM turn WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, status, trigger_ids AS triggerIds, outbox_ids AS outboxIds, silent_reason AS silentReason, error_code AS errorCode, accepted_at AS acceptedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt FROM turn WHERE platform = #{platform} AND bot_id = #{botId} AND group_id = #{groupId} AND status IN ('GENERATING', 'SETTLING')

SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, status, trigger_ids AS triggerIds, outbox_ids AS outboxIds, silent_reason AS silentReason, error_code AS errorCode, accepted_at AS acceptedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt FROM turn WHERE platform = #{platform} AND bot_id = #{botId} AND group_id = #{groupId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED' ORDER BY accepted_at

SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, status, trigger_ids AS triggerIds, outbox_ids AS outboxIds, silent_reason AS silentReason, error_code AS errorCode, accepted_at AS acceptedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt FROM turn WHERE status IN ('ACCEPTED', 'GENERATING', 'SETTLING')

SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, status, trigger_ids AS triggerIds, outbox_ids AS outboxIds, silent_reason AS silentReason, error_code AS errorCode, accepted_at AS acceptedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt FROM turn WHERE status = 'ACCEPTED' AND accepted_at < #{deadline}
